title: "INTEGRATOR"
subtitle: "Peak detection, picking, and integration for targeted MRM mass spectrometry"
description: |
  INTEGRATOR is the stand-alone peak-integration application of the MRMhub pipeline. It reads
  mzML files, finds and integrates MRM peaks, and exports long.csv / quant_raw.csv for downstream
  quantitation in the QUANT R package.
toc: false
---

**INTEGRATOR** is the stand-alone peak-integration module of the MRMhub pipeline. It takes
converted mzML files, detects and integrates MRM peaks across all your samples, lets you review
and fine-tune the results interactively, and exports tables ready for quantitation.

It ships as a small, self-contained executable for macOS and Windows — **nothing to install, no
Python or R required**. Keep one copy in each analysis project folder and the whole project stays
re-runnable.

::: {.callout-note}
**Just want post-processing in R?** INTEGRATOR is not required to use the QUANT R package — QUANT
imports directly from vendor outputs (MassHunter, Skyline) as well. See the
[QUANT documentation ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/).
:::

## Next step in the pipeline

Once INTEGRATOR produces `long.csv`, hand it off to the **QUANT** R package for ISTD
normalisation, drift/batch correction, calibration, QC, and reporting:

```r
import_data_mrmhub("path/to/long.csv", import_metadata = TRUE)
```

See the [QUANT documentation ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/) to continue.
